title: Multiplication register program
statement: Define a register program with $13$ registers, two oracle deciders, and the finite set of states specified for the multiplication procedure. In each state, its instruction is given by the displayed transition table: the program uses register increments, decrements, clearing, halving, zero, parity, and equality tests, and calls the indicated oracle on the specified virtual input; its terminal states return the indicated Boolean answer.
caveat: The formal definition supplies a large state-by-state instruction table; this concise description does not reproduce every branch and call in that table.
